meta.name: HeadUpDisplay
meta.description: Head-up display module, instantiated only for vehicle models equipped with the corresponding hardware. Supports enabling/disabling the display, brightness, and projection position adjustment. Displays information supplied by vehicle and navigation modules without holding a second set of speed or route state. Projection range and supported display content are fixed capabilities; augmented reality and automated driving are not implicit base capabilities.

enabled.description: Whether the head-up display is enabled.

brightness.description: Normalized display brightness percentage within the hardware-supported brightness range.

projection_position.description: Normalized projection position within the hardware-supported adjustment range, where 0 is the lowest position and 100 is the highest.

supported_content.description: Fixed content capability profile indicating that the display can present information supplied by vehicle and navigation modules.

get_enabled.description: Return whether the head-up display is enabled without changing state.

enabled.description: Whether the head-up display is enabled.

set_enabled.description: Enable or disable the head-up display. The brightness and projection position settings are preserved when the display is disabled. Invalid input is rejected without changing state.

get_brightness.description: Return the normalized head-up display brightness percentage without changing state.

set_brightness.description: Set the normalized head-up display brightness to an integer percentage from 0 through 100. The setting may be configured while the display is disabled and takes effect when enabled. Invalid input is rejected without changing state.

errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Brightness must be an integer from 0 through 100.

get_projection_position.description: Return the normalized projection position without changing state.

projection_position.description: Normalized projection position from 0 at the lowest supported position to 100 at the highest.

set_projection_position.description: Set the normalized projection position to an integer percentage from 0 through 100 within the hardware-supported adjustment range. The setting may be configured while the display is disabled. Invalid input is rejected without changing state.

errorcodes.INVALID_INPUT_ERROR: Projection position must be an integer from 0 through 100.

get_supported_content.description: Return the fixed supported-content capability profile. This reports the categories of externally supplied information the display can present and does not return or duplicate current speed, route, or navigation state.
